data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year reserve strengthening of USD 9.135 million, representing 49.08% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was primarily driven by adverse development on the 2016 underwriting year, which was impacted by natural catastrophe events, specifically Hurricanes Harvey and Irma. The report also notes the material natural catastrophe exposure from Hurricanes Michael and Florence impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account. The overall reserving process is described as judgmental and inherently uncertain, with potential for actual losses to differ from estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: frequency or severity of insured events will be higher than expected (claims risk)
estimates of claims subsequently prove to be insufficient (reserving risk)
provision for claims outstanding is subject to significant variability
establishing this liability is a judgmental and inherently uncertain process
actual losses may not conform to the assumptions that the directors used in determining the amount of this provision
ultimate provision may be significantly greater or less than the outstanding amount held at the balance sheet date
